# Dilip Kumar - Electronics Engineer & Software Developer Portfolio

> Personal portfolio and project showcase of Dilip Kumar, an Electronics Engineering student at Government Polytechnic Patna-7.

## Overview
Dilip Kumar explores electronics engineering, circuit design, Android development, Python programming, and AI-assisted workflows.

## Key Projects
- [ElectroKit](https://github.com/dk2017044/ElectroKit): All-in-one Android electronics toolkit for engineering students.
- [Python Turtle Projects](https://github.com/dk2017044): Creative graphics, algorithmic patterns, and math experiments.
- [Practical Electronics & Circuits](https://dilip-port.vercel.app/): Hardware testing, sensor prototyping, and circuit design.
- [AI & Software Lab](https://dilip-port.vercel.app/): Generative AI applications and prompt engineering experiments.
